blocks.text: LILOAN, Cebu – What if getting ahead did not mean leaving others behind? Miss Universe Philippines 2026 Bea Millan-Windorski raised this question from an international stage when she introduced what she called “turtle mentality” during the final Q & A round of the 75th Miss Universe competition. Asked what the world needs most from its leaders, the 24-year-old beauty queen from La Union drew from her long experience of volunteering for sea turtle conservation. “As someone who has been an environmentalist my whole life, I wish that our world leaders would listen to nature and realize that we have much to […]...
